title: Cokret Realm Read + Moderation-Policy Operation DTOs
description: Closed request/response DTOs for the self-surface Realm read operations and moderation-policy management (ck.self.realm.*). Realm read returns the lifecycle projection; export returns a full event-log + operation dump; effective moderation-policy returns the organization-inherited merged view; the moderation-policy override write builds a ck.realm.moderation_policy fact (subject to organization approval). See spec/v1/zh/models/realm-and-space.md and spec/v1/zh/governance/content-moderation.md.

operations.description: Operation dump rows {operation_id, realm_id, object_type, operation_type, payload, created_at}.

events.description: Event-log dump rows {event_id, realm_id, event_kind, operation_type, operation_id, sender, payload, created_at}.

realm_effective_moderation_policy.$comment: Open extension surface: the merged moderation-policy view carries deployment-defined organization/realm policy layers and fanout metadata; additionalProperties intentionally true so servers may surface implementation-specific layer detail without a wire-breaking change.

inheritance_chain.description: Organization DIDs (or deployment-local organization identifiers) contributing policy layers, parent-first.

realm_moderation_policy_replace_request_.$comment: Open extension surface: the ck.realm.moderation_policy document body is a free-form governance object (rules[], targets[], allow_override[], organization_approval[]); additionalProperties intentionally true so the override schema can evolve without a wire-breaking change. The document is canonical-JSON validated server-side.
realm_moderation_policy_replace_request_.description: Realm moderation-policy override body. Free-form ck.realm.moderation_policy document. When the override targets actions an organization policy denies, it requires explicit organization approval embedded in the document.
